data.title: Electric Bikes Support 'Absher Travel for Visitors' Service at Land Border Crossings
data.content:
Riyadh, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The General Directorate of Passports is streamlining entry procedures for travelers at land border crossings by deploying electric bikes for passport security personnel to assist users of the "Absher Travel for Visitors" service, which is available to citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries and visitors arriving in the Kingdom. The bikes allow personnel to reach users faster and provide them with support.
    The directorate encourages travelers to use the service via the Absher app. The service will become mandatory six months after October 26, 2026. It is designed to automate entry procedures for travelers and their vehicles by allowing them to complete travel requirements digitally before arriving at the border crossing.
    -- SPA
